title: Report progress for touched roadmap items
summary: Each development progress report should show progress for every phase, milestone, task and feature worked on during its reporting interval.
statement: Each development progress report should show progress for every phase, milestone, task and feature worked on during its reporting interval.
rationale: Public-safe, scoped project-development requirement normalized from an independently authorized specimen.

conditions: A project progress report covers work performed during the reporting interval.
exceptions: Items whose completed state was already announced and not reopened.
